description: Experience premium performance and immersive entertainment with the Infinix Note Edge, a feature-packed 5G smartphone designed for users who demand speed, style, and reliability. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 Octa-Core processor with a clock speed of up to 2.4 GHz, this smartphone delivers smooth multitasking, responsive gaming, and seamless everyday performance. Paired with 8GB RAM and 256GB internal storage, it provides plenty of space for apps, photos, videos, and documents while ensuring lag-free operation. The stunning 6.78-inch Punch-Hole AMOLED Display offers vibrant colors, deep contrast, and sharp visuals, making every movie, game, and social media experience more immersive. Its elegant Silk Green finish enhances the premium look while maintaining a comfortable grip for everyday use. Capture your favorite moments with the 50MP AI Rear Camera, capable of producing detailed and vibrant photographs in various lighting conditions.
